name: vault-browse-no-storage
comment: Vault Browse face execution plan, Slice 9 (empty states): the true 'no storage configured' cause (design §4.5), with NO --seed at all so the tagged app boots with zero Vault config of any kind. Proves the pre-Vault onboarding screen (qml/VaultPage.qml's vaultDropSurface, unchanged by this slice - see the design decision recorded in commit e26e189) keeps owning this cause rather than the compact plate-6 empty-state treatment, which has no drag-drop and would regress a real shipped capability. hasConfirmedStorage stays false (VaultLibrary.rootsDetail() is empty), so the browse face (rail/crumb/grid) never renders at all for this cause.

steps.label: the session answers, drive gated on
one visible window, isolated data root
the boot splash has left the screen
open the Vault via the folder door
the no-storage onboarding screen is visible - no config, no roots
Add folder is reachable from this state
